Depending on the specific company named
Zephyr Technology
you mean, the brands and manufacturers handled vary widely across industries:
Zephyr Technologies (Electronic Components Distributor):
Operates as a franchised/regional distributor serving the Americas and international markets for electronic components, memory, and semiconductors—including partner manufacturers like
XTX Technology
, Nuvoton Technology, SETfuse, SIMCom, and Unisonic (UTC).
LinkedIn
Zephyr Technology Corporation (Physiological Monitoring / Medical):
Known for the BioHarness and wireless telehealth systems, which were acquired by Covidien (later Medtronic).
Zephyr (Garden & Industrial Hose Reels):
An Indian brand manufacturing heavy-duty auto-retractable hose reels and rubber water hoses (similarly marketed as BluBird in the US).
Zephyr Manufacturing Co. (Cleaning Products):
A family-owned North American manufacturer supplying mops, brooms, and industrial cleaning accessories.

which industry or region
(e.g., electronics, medical, or consumer goods) your Zephyr Technology inquiry targets, I can provide a more precise list.
